newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 3-day system RPs, not fixed.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 3-day system RPs, not fixed.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system on Monday via three-day system repurchase agreements, not fixed, a Fed spokesman confirmed.
Analysts had anticipated the open market operation, citing a reserve add need of $4.0 billion to $5.0 billion a day for the remainder of the current bank reserve maintenance period.
Fed funds were trading at 5-5/16 percent at the time of the operation, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate. -- North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679
